# Newer releases this project does not take, on purpose. The weekly report lists them apart, with
# the reason, and they alone don't keep the report issue open. Known vulnerabilities are reported
# whatever this file says.
#
# One per line: the crate, the newer version held back, the reason. Both the crate and the
# version may use * as a wildcard. A version pattern stops matching once a release beyond it
# comes out, so that release shows up again for a fresh look.
